title: Per-match random soft-block layout — fresh roll each match under the same arena skeleton
intent: Source: arena-complexity spike (S230) #2 (tied) recommendation. Today the same arena rolled with the same seed always produces the same soft-block layout. Players who play the same map twice see the SAME crate pattern + the SAME pickup positions. This story makes each match reroll the soft-block layout under the same arena skeleton — every match is a fresh first encounter even on the same map. Deterministic per session-seed + match-number so spectators / replays still agree.
rationale: Spike scored 13/15. Reuses the existing seeded-RNG roll (S82 + S89). The change is feeding `MatchState.matchNumber` into the seed so the random hash differs per match. ~30 LOC bootstrap reroute + URL flag. Pairs naturally with the per-region density variation (GDP-2026-06-02-004) — that defines WHERE blocks can spawn, this defines IF they spawn each match.
acceptanceHints: TARGET: `examples/kaboom-crew/src/blocks/per-cell-variant-selector.ts` and the soft-block spawn roll site (likely in scene-load or scene-expansion).

MECHANISM: extend the existing `selectVariantIndex(gx, gz, sceneSeed)` (or equivalent) to ALSO mix in `MatchState.matchNumber`. The seed becomes `(sceneSeed ^ matchNumber)` — same shape as `cellHash` from S82.
FALLBACK: when no MatchState is present (single-round runs, demo-30s tests), default to matchNumber=1. demo-30s regression baseline must stay byte-identical (matchNumber=1 in that test).
`?matchSeed=N` override the matchNumber input — useful for replays / debug.
`?randomLayout=off` disable the reroll, fall back to the original deterministic-by-arena behaviour. Used by bot-vs-bot regression tests if they need a stable layout.
Unit: same arena + same matchNumber → identical layout. Different matchNumber → different layout.
Unit: missing MatchState → matchNumber defaults to 1 (deterministic with the pre-S230 baseline).
demo-30s regression: snapshot stays byte-identical because the test world doesn't bump matchNumber.
Visual: load `wide` arena, restart match → soft-block crate pattern visibly differs from the first match.
Random hard-block lattice (keep the odd/even grid — it's load-bearing for pathfinding).
Random pickup TYPE per match (pickup-spawn-system rolls per-cell already; that's enough).
Random hazard placement (separate story, depends on more hazard primitives).
Symmetric-arena guarantee — when the random roll makes one side denser than the other, accept it. Players who want strict balance can `?randomLayout=off`.
